construct: A somatic PIGA mutation in a hematopoietic stem cell impairs glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchor biosynthesis, causing loss of GPI-anchored complement regulators such as CD55 and CD59 and thereby permitting complement-mediated intravascular hemolysis and thrombosis.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Coombs-negative intravascular hemolysis plus unusual-site thrombosis and clonal loss of both CD55 and CD59 across blood-cell lineages identifies PNH from an acquired PIGA-mutant clone with defective GPI-anchor synthesis.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: An isolated inherited CD55 defect cannot explain concurrent loss of CD59 across a clone; factor-H dysregulation causes complement-mediated TMA rather than GPI-anchor loss; spectrin disease causes hereditary spherocytosis; G6PD deficiency causes oxidant-triggered hemolysis.
